dialogue.content: こんにちわ。宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: 少し早いので、準備が整いましたら、お知らせくださいね。
dialogue.English: We're a little early, so please let me know when you're ready.

dialogue.content: こんにちはよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: もう、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: I'm ready now.

dialogue.content: はい、それでは始めさせて頂きますね。
dialogue.English: Alright, then let's begin.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm your counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 黒人の彼と結婚したいのです
dialogue.English: I want to marry my Black boyfriend.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！国境を越えた結婚を・・。そこでどんな事で、今お困りですか？
dialogue.English: I see. An international marriage. What kinds of challenges are you facing right now?

dialogue.content: 母から、猛反対を受ける可能性が高く、とても辛い状況です
dialogue.English: There's a strong chance my mother will be vehemently opposed, and it's a very painful situation for me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは、とても、つらいですね・・。どのような反対が受けそうなのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very difficult. What kind of objections do you expect she'll have?

dialogue.content: 反対を・・です。
dialogue.English: Opposition, I mean.

dialogue.content: 私と、子供が絶対いじめに合う、とか、黒人男性を親族として受け入れられない、結婚するなら、縁を切る、とつい会い出した頃に、いわれたことが、あるのです
dialogue.English: When we first started dating, she told me things like, 'You and any children you have will definitely be bullied,' 'I can't accept a Black man as family,' and 'If you marry him, I'll disown you.'

dialogue.content: それは、矢継ぎ早な辛い言葉ばかりですね。悲しくなりますよね・・
dialogue.English: That's a barrage of hurtful words. It must be heartbreaking.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 相談者さんは、お母さんからそんな事言われて、その時、なんって返事されたのですか？
dialogue.English: When your mother said those things to you, how did you respond at the time?

dialogue.content: あまり覚えていないのですが、とてもショックでした
dialogue.English: I don't remember very well, but I was very shocked.

dialogue.content: ええ、とてもショックですよね。結婚したいと思ってるから、耳を疑うような言葉ですものね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that must have been a huge shock. Since you want to get married, those words must have been unbelievable to hear.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お母さんから言われた言葉に対して、本心はどのように思われましたか？
dialogue.English: Deep down, how did you feel about what your mother said?

dialogue.content: 相談者ではなく、名前で呼んでいただけませんか
dialogue.English: Could you please call me by my name instead of 'client'?

dialogue.content: 失礼いたしました。お名前と、年齢を教えて頂いても、宜しいですか？
dialogue.English: I apologize. Would you mind telling me your name and age?

dialogue.content: ２４才、未来といいます
dialogue.English: I'm 24 years old, and my name is Mirai.

dialogue.content: 未来さんですね、ありがとうございます。素敵なお名前ですね。
dialogue.English: Mirai, thank you. That's a lovely name.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 縁を切るとか言われて辛かったですね・・お母さんの言葉を受けて、未来さんはどのように、思われましたか？
dialogue.English: It must have been painful to be told she'd disown you. After hearing your mother's words, what were your thoughts, Mirai?

dialogue.content: 結婚相手は、自分で決めたい、と思いましたが、私が幼い頃に、母は育児ノイローゼで、真剣を一時放棄したことがあります。でも、育ててくれたことに、感謝しています。
dialogue.English: I felt that I want to choose my own marriage partner, but when I was little, my mother suffered a nervous breakdown from the stress of parenting and temporarily gave up her parental rights. Still, I'm grateful that she raised me.

dialogue.content: でも、
dialogue.English: But...

dialogue.content: うんうん、
dialogue.English: Mhm, mhm.

dialogue.content: 身近で、精神的に支えてくれる存在を得られないと不安に思います。情けない自分です
dialogue.English: I get anxious if I don't have someone close by to support me emotionally. I feel so pathetic.

dialogue.content: いえ、未来さんが不安に思うのも当然のお気持ちです。そんな、お母さんの育児への不安だった経験や、
dialogue.English: No, it's perfectly natural for you to feel anxious, Mirai. Considering your mother's own experience with the anxieties of raising a child, and...

dialogue.content: お母さんだけでなく、未来さんも児放棄された経験がおありで、これまで、つらい思いもされてきたのではないでしょうか・・
dialogue.English: ...not only that, but you also have the experience of being given up by her. You must have gone through some very painful times until now.

dialogue.content: そうかな？・・
dialogue.English: You think so...?

dialogue.content: 親権放棄ですよね。その辺はお気持ちいかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: She gave up her parental rights, correct? How did you feel about that?

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: でも、ちゃんと育ててくれたので、感謝しています
dialogue.English: But she did raise me properly in the end, so I'm grateful.

dialogue.content: そうですか。未来さんがちゃんと感謝してると、受け取っておられる様子で安心しました
dialogue.English: I see. I'm relieved to see that you genuinely feel that gratitude, Mirai.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一方で、
dialogue.English: On the other hand,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お母さんの反対するお気持ちもくみ取っておられるように感じているのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I get the sense that you're also trying to understand your mother's reasons for opposing the marriage. Is that right?

dialogue.content: はい、そうかもしれません
dialogue.English: Yes, that might be true.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・感謝しておられるから、お母さんの認めた人とに祝福されて、、、と思いますよね。
dialogue.English: Right... Because you're grateful to her, you want to marry someone she approves of and have her blessing... I imagine that's how you feel.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's it exactly.

dialogue.content: 結婚したい彼はどんな性格の方だと思いますか？
dialogue.English: What kind of person is the man you want to marry?

dialogue.content: 仕事熱心で、人望が厚く、家族を大切にする、誠実で温かい人です
dialogue.English: He's hardworking, well-respected, values family, and is a sincere and warm person.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・とても、魅力的な素敵な男性ですね！
dialogue.English: I see... he sounds like a very charming and wonderful man!

dialogue.content: そうなんです・・・照れてしまいます
dialogue.English: He is... it makes me blush to say it.

dialogue.content: 素敵です！そんなお話は、お母さんやお父さんは、聴いてくれそうですか？
dialogue.English: That's lovely. Do you think your mother and father would be willing to listen to you talk about him like that?

dialogue.content: 父は、他界しました。母は、私とは違っているので、無理だと思います
dialogue.English: My father has passed away. My mother is different from me, so I don't think it's possible.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、お父さん。お母さんは自分とは違うと、お思いなんですね。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry to hear about your father. And you feel that your mother is different from you.

dialogue.content: それは、どんな所から強くそう感じますか？
dialogue.English: What makes you feel that so strongly?

dialogue.content: はい、祖母と母は、私とは違うんです
dialogue.English: Yes, my grandmother and my mother are different from me.

dialogue.content: 祖母まで違うんですね・・
dialogue.English: Your grandmother too...

dialogue.content: 非常に保守的な価値観を持っています
dialogue.English: They hold very conservative values.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。確かに、子育てに関してもそんな風ですものね・・その心配を、今、お母さんは、未来さんに投影してしまっていると思います
dialogue.English: I understand. That certainly seems to be how she approaches child-rearing as well... I think your mother is now projecting those same worries onto you, Mirai.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see... so that's what it is.

dialogue.content: お母さんは自分が出来なかった事や、心配や、不安を、きっと未来さんも同じ事で、思い悩み苦しむと、心配で心配で・・
dialogue.English: Your mother is worried sick that you, Mirai, will also struggle and suffer with the same things she couldn't handle—her own worries and anxieties.

dialogue.content: そうなる前にと必死なんでしょうね。
dialogue.English: She's likely desperate to prevent that from happening.

dialogue.content: でも、未来さんは確かに違います！
dialogue.English: But you, Mirai, are definitely different!

dialogue.content: そうなんでしょうか詳しくは、どういうことですか
dialogue.English: Am I? What do you mean by that, specifically?

dialogue.content: ちゃんと未来さん自身で、この人と思った彼と、結婚したい道を決めていきたいという強い気持ちがあると聞いていて、感じていました。
dialogue.English: From what you've told me, I sense that you have a strong desire to choose your own path and marry the man you truly believe is the one for you.

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 彼の事もちゃんと理解して、お母さんが心配してる事も理解して、ちゃんと感謝もされてる。
dialogue.English: You understand him well, you understand what your mother is worried about, and you truly feel gratitude as well.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: お母さんが、後、おっけーと言ってくれたら、悩みは解消ってぐらいに、嬉しいのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Wouldn't it be such a relief, and make you so happy, if your mother just gave you her approval?

dialogue.content: 親の価値観に振り回されずに、意思決定するには、どうするべきでしょうか
dialogue.English: How can I make my own decisions without being swayed by my mother's values?

dialogue.content: 親の価値観は、親の物です。振り回されてると感じてるんですよね、辛いですよね。意思決定は、
dialogue.English: Your mother's values belong to her. It's painful to feel like you're being swayed by them, isn't it? As for making the decision,

dialogue.content: 自分一人で決定しないで、沢山味方を増やすのも良いでしょうね。
dialogue.English: it might be a good idea not to decide all by yourself, but to gather a lot of allies.

dialogue.content: はい、例えば・・・？
dialogue.English: Okay, for example...?

dialogue.content: 親戚のおばちゃんにちょっと電話してみたり
dialogue.English: Maybe you could give an aunt a call,

dialogue.content: 先ほど言われた彼の話をしてみるとか。黒人とかは気にしなくていいですよ！
dialogue.English: and talk about him the way you just described him to me. You don't need to bring up that he's Black.

dialogue.content: 自分に無理だと思ったことは、人は、反対するので。
dialogue.English: People tend to oppose things that they believe would be impossible for themselves.

dialogue.content: 話を母にするのは、こわいのです。一度、反対されているので
dialogue.English: I'm afraid to talk to my mother about it, since she has already opposed it once.

dialogue.content: ええ、こわいですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's scary, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: また反対されたらとか、ひどい言葉を投げかけてきたら、とか思いますものね、だけど
dialogue.English: You worry that she'll oppose you again or say more hurtful things. But...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その言葉以上に、彼と結ばれないかもしれないと思ったら、もっと、苦しい状況になりませんか？
dialogue.English: Compared to those words, wouldn't the thought of not being able to marry him be an even more painful situation?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 具体的には、どうすればよいですか
dialogue.English: Specifically, what should I do?

dialogue.content: なので、今出来る事、お伝えすると
dialogue.English: So, if I may suggest something you can do now...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 彼と一緒に過ごす時間は幸せだったと、アピールする。
dialogue.English: Make a point of showing her how happy you are when you spend time with him.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Okay...

dialogue.content: 一緒になれないと思ったら、こんなに辛いと、お母さんに伝わるといいなと思いました。それで、
dialogue.English: I was thinking it would be good if you could convey to your mother just how painful the thought of not being able to be with him is for you. And then,

dialogue.content: アピールしてもだめだと思うんです
dialogue.English: I don't think emphasizing it will do any good.

dialogue.content: 駄目？んー、そうですね。ならば、絶対幸せになってみる、はどうですか？
dialogue.English: It won't? Hmm, I see. In that case, how about this: resolve to be happy no matter what.

dialogue.content: はい、唱えるのですか
dialogue.English: Okay... you mean like I should chant it to myself?

dialogue.content: 実際に強行突破で、結婚しちゃう！やってみないと分かりませんよね。
dialogue.English: I mean actually forcing the issue—just go ahead and get married! You won't know how it will turn out unless you try.

dialogue.content: 短い時間の会話ですが、未来さんなら出来ると、思いました！
dialogue.English: It's only been a short conversation, but I truly believe that you can do it, Mirai!

dialogue.content: そうですか、母には、通用しないような気がします
dialogue.English: You think so? I have a feeling that won't work with my mother.

dialogue.content: 結婚するのは、お母さんではないですよね。
dialogue.English: It's not your mother who's getting married, is it?

dialogue.content: お母さんの漆もなければ・・と思いまして
dialogue.English: I was just thinking... if I don't have my mother's approv—

dialogue.content: 許し
dialogue.English: Approval.

dialogue.content: お母さんの許可は、正直欲しいです。だけど、オッケーはもらえそうにない。別れて幸せになる保証もない。許可が無くても幸せにはなれます。自分の意志で決めたことならばね。
dialogue.English: Honestly, you want your mother's permission. But it seems unlikely you'll get it. There's no guarantee you'll be happy if you break up, either. You can be happy even without her permission, as long as it's your own decision.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: でも、
dialogue.English: But...

dialogue.content: はい、後悔するんじゃないかとか不安ですよね。自分で決めた事は後悔しても、良い後悔ってあるんですよ
dialogue.English: Yes, you're anxious you might regret it, aren't you? But even if you regret a decision you made for yourself, there is such a thing as a 'good regret'.

dialogue.content: やっぱり心配で、不安で、勇気がいります母の許可がほしいです
dialogue.English: I'm still worried and anxious; it takes courage. I want my mother's permission.

dialogue.content: 不安ですよね。決断するには、大きな覚悟がいりますよね。なので、今は彼の存在が、未来さんを幸せにしてくれるを、
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel anxious. Making a decision like this requires a great deal of resolve. So, for now, the fact that his presence makes you happy, Mirai...

dialogue.content: 小出しにして、理解を求めつつ、ただ、お母さんの思ってるほど、未来さんは彼と結婚することで苦労しないって事は、
dialogue.English: ...maybe you can drop little hints about that to seek her understanding, while also showing that marrying him won't cause you to struggle as much as she thinks,

dialogue.content: 諦めないで、大好きな彼と結ばれて欲しいです。
dialogue.English: I hope you won't give up and will be able to be with the man you love so much.

dialogue.content: 長々と、失礼しました。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry for talking for so long.

dialogue.content: いえ、こちらこそ、失礼しました
dialogue.English: No, not at all. Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: もっとお話したいのですが、申し訳ありません。時間が過ぎてしまいました。未来さんならお母さんとは違う、自分の意志で決めて、一歩前へ進まれると、信じています。応援しています。
dialogue.English: I wish we could talk more, but I'm afraid our time is up. I believe that you, Mirai, are different from your mother and that you can make your own decision and take a step forward. I'm rooting for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日は、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。終了ボタン押させて頂きますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today. I'm going to press the 'end' button now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.
